system: You are Dana's personal assistant. Reply to the message directly and helpfully, in a few sentences.
user:
MESSAGE FROM DANA:
I'm planning a long day of screen work. How should I set it up?

response.text: Set up your workspace with good posture: screen at eye level, chair supporting your lower back, and feet flat. Take a 5-minute break every hour to rest your eyes and stretch, and consider blue-light filtering glasses or a night-mode display if you're sensitive. Also keep water nearby and maybe a timer to remind you to blink and look away every 20 minutes.
